items.markdown:
The Thailand Non-Immigrant "ED" (Education) Visa is `for foreign nationals enrolled in approved educational programs, university courses, internships, or training seminars in Thailand` . It requires an acceptance letter from an accredited institution, proof of funds, and strict class attendance.[](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/education-visa) [[1]](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/education-visa)[[2]](https://www.siam-legal.com/Foreign-Citizens/thailand-education-visa-foreign.php)[[3]](https://www.thaiembassy.at/en/type-of-visa/non-immigrant-visa-ed-education.html)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZC1r42nmOlY&t=10)[[5]](https://www.educationvisathailand.com/)[[6]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/pK8fu2meJkc)

Application Requirements

- **Acceptance Letter:** Official documentation from a certified Thai school, university, or ministry-approved organization.
- **Financial Proof:** Bank statements showing funds (typically around 20,000 to 50,000 THB equivalent) to cover living costs.
- **Course Fees:** Receipt showing at least 50% payment of tuition or program costs.
- **Supporting Documents:** Valid passport (at least 6 months validity), passport photos, and official letters from the Thai Ministry of Education.[](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/education-visa) [[1]](https://www.findawayabroad.com/post/in-thailand-on-an-education-visa)

Visa Terms and Extensions

- **Initial Entry:** Issued as a 90-day single-entry visa requiring activation upon arrival in Thailand.
- **Extensions:** Can be extended at local Thai Immigration offices for up to one year, provided you maintain active enrollment and attendance.
- **Work Restrictions:** Does not permit standard employment without obtaining a separate official work permit.[](https://www.thaiembassy.at/en/type-of-visa/non-immigrant-visa-ed-education.html) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xUScn9hHW3k&t=235)[[2]](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/education-visa)[[3]](https://cmkl.ac.th/students/visa-maintaining-status)

If you would like more targeted guidance, tell me:

- **What do you plan to study?** (e.g., Thai language, university degree, vocational training)
- **Where are you applying from?** 

I can give you the specific paperwork checklist and steps for your situation.
